title: Tested: 2026 Volkswagen Golf GTI Edition 50 - Full review, price & features | Autocar
quote: However, the overall picture is an impressive one. The Edition 50 puts its power down cleanly, rides with class and sophistication and during cornering will permit you to lean its outside with a vigour unbeknown to the GTI Clubsport.

title: The Rules of Engagement: Aston Martin DB12 S Drive
quote: A big power number and improved handling make little sense if you don't enjoy every mile behind the wheel, and in the DB12 S, you absolutely do.

title: The 2027 BMW X5 Drives Great, but Some Elements May Not Be for Everyone
quote: The ride quality is remarkable in its softer drive-mode settings, flattening road imperfections and letting nary a shudder into the cabin.

title: 2027 BMW X5 and iX5 First Drive Review: A Modern SUV, Like It or Not
quote: The transmission is quick and smooth, too, and the whole powertrain is quiet, even at full throttle. The steering offers more feedback than I expected, and while it doesn't deliver sports-car-level responsiveness, you can tell BMW put effort into tuning the overall steering feel.

title: 2027 BMW M350 Prototype Drive: Neue Klasse Is a Gas
quote: The M350 xDrive delivers most of the performance and fun you’d expect from an M3, without being so keyed up all the time. Granted, this was a prototype, but things look promising for the Neue Klasse to return the 3-series to its old status as the one car to do it all.

title: BMW 3 Series prototype review: “a step forward for its kind” Reviews 2026 | Top Gear
quote: You can't, though, tell which of the chassis control systems is doing what – the diffs or the dampers or the brake vectoring. They just integrate into a lovely fluent result.

title: The 2027 BMW 7-Series Embraces Luxurious Maximalism
quote: The difference between the gas-powered BMW and its electric i7 sibling is barely a whisper of pistons, the smallest shudder of stop-start. The 2027 BMW 740 and i7 are near silent in motion. But their design? That’s glittery and loud.

title: 2027 BMW 7 Series and i7 First Drive: Neue Klasse, Old-School Luxury
quote: The 7 Series and i7 aren't all-new, but they didn't need to be. They were already at the top of their class, and the addition of the latest BMW tech means the pair still feel like proper flagship models.
